_comment: Copy to .orca/local/workers.json (gitignored). The driver re-reads it before EVERY dispatch, so editing it between waves switches harness/model without restarting the driver. Add a preset for a new harness (e.g. cursor) here; nothing else needs to change.
_effort_levels: low | medium | high | max  (this Orca build; xhigh is not valid)
_agents: claude | codex today; cursor is accepted by worker-start --agent when you add a preset for it
